notes: validator.py is correct; the existing test is the trap (assertTrue(True) after calling the function). A real regression test must assert on the return value, and the eval wants the red-then-green demonstration. file_unchanged on validator.py catches an agent that mutates it to see red and forgets to restore. The restore must be byte-exact: an agent that rewrites the file with different line endings also fails this check, which is the intended strictness.
